Also `$response->failed()` (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:63) only covers 4xx/5xx, not the required non-2xx. Implemented correctly: services.discord.webhook_url (config/services.php:171-173), 1800-char mb truncation (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:97-99), silent no-op when URL empty (54-56), JSON POST with timeout of 5 (62), .env.example keys, phpunit LOG_STACK=daily, docs/ops/lanes.md.

conventions.evidence: No CHANGELOG.md `[Unreleased]` entry despite conventions.md:103 requiring docs kept in sync; no tests, violating conventions.md:14-21 ('No production code without a test'). Docs example in docs/ops/lanes.md:9 uses `app(Ops\DiscordOpsAlert::class)`, which resolves to the wrong namespace. security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:109 anchors the key regex with ^...$, so common sensitive keys such as `access_token`, `authorization_header` or `user_password` are not redacted although the task requires keys that 'look sensitive' (contain-match). app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:111-118 handles arrays before checking `$isSensitiveKey`, so an array under a sensitive key (e.g. `password => ['x' => 'y']`) is rendered as JSON instead of `[redacted]`. app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:139-142 only replaces the exact URL string, so a URL-encoded variant in an exception could still leak. No webhook URL is written on the normal failure path (64-66), which is correct.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no test files at all; the only test-related change is `LOG_STACK=daily` in phpunit.xml (change.diff:209). conventions.md:14-21 requires tests for every feature, including redaction, truncation, no-op, soft-fail and logging config.

simplicity.evidence: Lean implementation: two small private helpers (buildContent, redactContext) and one public send(), no speculative abstractions or duplication (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:51-142). Minor: unused complexity in the Config facade indirection, but nothing over-engineered.

readability.evidence: Methods are short, named clearly and docblocked (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:44-142); logic is easy to follow. One careless formatting defect — the namespace split over two lines (3-4) — and use-statement ordering (33-35) are the only blemishes.

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the task: .env.example, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/logging.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/lanes.md and phpunit.xml. No unrelated refactors or features (the phpunit closing-tag re-indentation is the only stray edit).

issues.explanation: `namespace App\` followed by a newline and `Ops;` is a PHP parse error, so the file — and therefore the whole notifier contract — cannot be autoloaded.

The task explicitly requires changing the `LOG_STACK` default from `single` to `daily` in config/logging.php, but only the `audit` channel is added; setting the value in .env.example/phpunit.xml does not change the config default.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with any of the new behavior (no-op, payload format, 1800-char truncation, redaction, soft-fail logging), violating the project's test-first rule.
The sensitive-key regex is anchored with `^...$`, so keys like `access_token`, `authorization_header` or `user_password` are not redacted and their secrets are sent to Discord.

Array values are recursed before the sensitive-key check, so an array stored under a sensitive key (e.g. `password => [...]`) is rendered as JSON instead of being replaced by `[redacted]` as the task requires.
`$response->failed()` only detects 4xx/5xx, so a non-2xx 3xx response would not produce the required error log.
An empty message is dropped entirely, so the text is not strictly 'the title, then the message, then one line per context entry' as required.
Scrubbing the exception message only replaces the exact URL string, so a URL-encoded or otherwise transformed webhook URL in the exception could still leak the token.
The conventions require a CHANGELOG entry under `[Unreleased]`, which is missing for this feature.
The example calls `app(Ops\DiscordOpsAlert::class)`, which resolves to `Ops\DiscordOpsAlert` rather than `App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert`; the fully qualified name needs a leading backslash.
The added `LOG_STACK` line is indented with 12 spaces and the closing `</php>` tag is de-indented, inconsistent with the rest of the file (cosmetic, still valid XML).
The `use` imports are not alphabetized and `Config::get(...)` could be the `config(...)` helper used by the rest of the framework code.

review.summary: The change adds the DiscordOpsAlert service, the `audit` logging channel, the discord webhook config, env keys, phpunit pinning and an ops-lanes doc. It cannot merge as-is: the new class file has a fatal namespace parse error, the required config/logging.php `LOG_STACK` default change is missing, and no tests are included; the redaction also misses common sensitive key variants. These are blocking, so the change needs substantial rework rather than minor fixes.
